name: National Center for Civil and Human Rights
address: 100 Ivan Allen Jr Blvd, Atlanta, GA 30313
tagline: The American civil rights movement and its global descendants. Sit-in simulator.
description: Three floors covering the American civil rights movement, the Martin Luther King Jr. archive, and global human rights work. The lunch-counter sit-in simulator (haptic feedback for the slurs and threats hurled at participants in 1960) is the centerpiece.
review_long:
The Rolls Down Like Water gallery on the second floor walks through the American civil rights movement chronologically. The lunch-counter simulator — wear headphones, sit at the counter, hold the chair to feel the real haptic feedback of the slurs and threats — is the most demanding two minutes you can spend in any Atlanta museum.

The MLK Archive on the third floor includes original handwritten drafts of his speeches.

highlights.item: Original Martin Luther King Jr. handwritten drafts

distance_landmark: Pemberton Place, opposite the Georgia Aquarium
